subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Suez Canal Blockage
description: A quick win: understand The Suez Canal Blockage.

hook.text: In March 2021, a 1,300-foot container ship ran aground sideways in the Suez Canal. Global trade froze.

buildup.text: The Ever Given blocked the canal for six days. About 12% of world trade flows through that waterway.

discovery.text: An estimated $9.6 billion in goods were delayed every single day the ship was stuck.

twist.text: The cause was mundane: strong crosswinds pushed the oversized ship into the bank. No technical failure.

climax.text: The incident exposed how concentrated and fragile global shipping routes have become.

punchline.text: One ship. One canal. Six days. The world felt it.

quiz.question: What caused the Ever Given to block the Suez Canal?
options: Strong crosswinds pushed the ship into the bank
